# Milestone brief — data-plane-governance-m3

**Title:** Trust-language and evidence-ledger policies committed and binding
**Kind:** milestone
**Roadmap:** data-plane-governance (plans/data-plane-governance/roadmap.yaml)
**Status:** planned
**Lane:** now
**Target:** 2026-07-16 -> 2026-07-23

## Parent epic

- data-plane-governance-e3 — Trust-language, abstention, and evidence-ledger policies
  Draft, owner-approve, and commit the trust-language policy at .claude/docs/trust-language-policy.md — banning any single verified-style enum on the MCP surface, defining the multi-axis trust-record dimensions (aligned against the stability-mflds rigor.py lattice, divergences recorded) and the abstention outcomes (unknown / ambiguous / not-in-corpus / unsupported-by-provider) as first-class tool results — plus the evidence-ledger standard for novelty claims with a bounded retro census pass over the R0-R7 brief-cited claims, and land the trust rules in CLAUDE.md; the R3/R5 briefs' tool-surface gates reference the policy.

## Summary

The trust-language policy at .claude/docs/trust-language-policy.md (verified-enum ban, multi-axis trust-record dimensions, abstention outcomes) and the evidence-ledger standard at .claude/docs/evidence-ledger-standard.md are owner-approved, committed, referenced from CLAUDE.md, and wired into the R3/R5 briefs' tool-surface gates, with the bounded retro census pass over R0-R7 brief-cited novelty claims complete.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Given the drafted policy at .claude/docs/trust-language-policy.md, when the owner approves and it is committed, then it bans any single verified-style enum on the MCP surface, defines the multi-axis trust-record dimensions with the stability-mflds rigor.py alignment mapping and divergences recorded, and defines the abstention outcomes (unknown / ambiguous / not-in-corpus / unsupported-by-provider) every tool must be able to return
2. Given the committed evidence-ledger standard at .claude/docs/evidence-ledger-standard.md, when any 'no system does X' novelty claim cited in the R0-R7 briefs is checked, then it carries a dated, scoped census naming the census set, the queries run, and the census date
3. Given the owner-approved policies, when CLAUDE.md is amended and the briefs are cross-referenced, then CLAUDE.md states the trust-language rules as binding agent constraints and the R3/R5 briefs' tool-surface gates reference .claude/docs/trust-language-policy.md

## Depends on

- data-plane-governance-m1 — Boundary ADR owner-approved, committed, and binding in CLAUDE.md [status: planned]
